name: Pranav Gonepalli
title: Software Engineer
headline: Building enterprise security platforms at Capital One.
about: Software engineer at Capital One, building and maintaining enterprise security platforms using Go and AWS. I hold a B.S. in Computer Science from William & Mary and am an AWS Certified Solutions Architect. My experience spans enterprise software, AI-powered applications, and high-performance data systems, with previous roles at MicroStrategy and IBM.

bullets: Engineered and maintained Chamber of Secrets, Capital One's enterprise secrets management platform, using Go — enabling secure secret creation, rotation, deletion, and access across engineering teams.
Applied secure-by-design principles and enforced security invariants across service layers, strengthening authentication, access control, and data protection workflows.
Implemented backend enhancements and resolved high-priority production issues, improving platform reliability, diagnosability, and operational stability while reducing support load.
Leveraged AWS Secrets Manager and CloudWatch to improve observability, auditability, and threat detection across the secret lifecycle.
Streamlined CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub, enabling safer, faster, and more consistent deployments.
Contributed to React-based frontend improvements and developer documentation, improving usability, accessibility, and self-service adoption.
Built an AI-powered natural language chatbot for Auto Dashboard using React, Node.js, and OpenAI, enabling automated dashboard generation.
Designed and implemented dynamic multi-page SPA workflows, improving dashboard creation time by 90%.
Developed responsive UI components and data flows using modern React patterns, improving user experience and performance.
Integrated frontend with RESTful APIs and asynchronous data pipelines for real-time dashboard rendering.
Built AWS Lambda-based pipelines to securely process and extract structured data from Hyperscience documents.
Containerized workloads with Docker to improve deployment consistency and system reliability.
Developed high-performance data processing scripts that analyzed 52,000+ JSON files, reducing processing time from months to minutes.

projects.name: Interactive SBOM Analyzer
bullets: Developed a full-stack security analysis platform to visualize SPDX and CycloneDX SBOMs as interactive dependency trees.
Built a React single-page application with dynamic rendering of deeply nested dependency graphs.
Implemented backend parsing pipelines to surface transitive vulnerabilities and license risks for security teams.
Improved software supply chain visibility and accelerated vulnerability triage workflows.
